basic_info.description: Price Improvement! St. Mary's bell is ringing and it's calling you back! This charming 3BD/2BA Spanish Revival has been cherished by the same family for nearly 20 yrs. A dream for commuters - it's less than 7-min to Glen Park BART without a car, with 280 & 101 just moments away and perfect for getting to downtown, the Peninsula, or the East Bay fast. Fully detached and flooded with natural light, it boasts huge bay windows, period details, and hardwood floors throughout. The inviting living room offers storybook views, a cozy fireplace & flows to an elegant dining room. A bright refreshed kitchen with a breakfast nook sits just beyond. Upstairs, 2 spacious BRs offer a peaceful retreat with twinkling views of University Mound at night, while downstairs, you'll find a third bedroom, a versatile bonus room ideal for a home office or gym, and a grand family room with a wet bar that opens to the sunny backyard  perfect for BBQs, slumber parties, and cocktail nights - this home was made for gathering! The large garage offers ample storage & laundry. A rare gem in a coveted enclave w/ a 97 Walk Score. Transparently priced!
